Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Abstract Area Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Blue, White
Materials: Nylon
Add interest to your home decor with this unique rug. Perfect for contemporary-style decor, this rug features blue lines lying in paintbrush-like strokes across a white background for a striking look that will enhance the modern ambience of your room. 5' x 8' Pile: 100% nylon The thick, soft pile of this luxurious brushstroke-patterned rug makes it both beautiful and practical. A handstitched binding gives it a handcrafted, elevated look. The medium 0.25" pile makes this rug perfect for medium- to high-traffic areas like bedrooms or living rooms. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
